description: This file contains functions for rendering 3D plane edges and faces using OpenGL, including color application and vertex positioning.

methods.name: void lu5_render_plane_edges(lua_Number half_x,lua_Number half_y,lu5_color color)

methods.description: Renders the filled face of a plane with specified half extents and color using OpenGL quadrilaterals.
